question: Hello
explanation: 你好 (nǐ hǎo) is the standard friendly greeting. Literally, the characters mean “you good.”

question: Could you help me?
explanation: 可以 (kěyǐ) means “can/may”; 帮我 (bāng wǒ) means “help me.” 吗 / 嗎 turns the phrase into a yes-or-no question.

question: I think this is a good idea
optionPinyin: tā bǐ wǒ lái de zǎo
explanation: 我觉得 / 我覺得 (wǒ juéde) means “I think,” while 不错 / 不錯 (búcuò) means “not bad” or “pretty good.”

question: Although I was tired, I still finished the work
simplifiedOptions: 虽然很累，但是我还是完成了工作。
因为下雨，所以我们没出门。
traditionalOptions: 雖然很累，但是我還是完成了工作。
因為下雨，所以我們沒出門。
optionPinyin: rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù
suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi wánchéng le gōngzuò
yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi chūmén
explanation: 虽然 / 雖然 (suīrán) introduces a concession (“although”); 但是 (dànshì) introduces the contrast (“but”).

question: What is this?
explanation: 这 / 這 (zhè) means “this,” 是 (shì) means “is,” and 什么 / 什麼 (shénme) means “what.”

question: I plan to travel next month
optionPinyin: wǒ yǐjīng lǚxíng le yí ge yuè
wǒ dǎsuàn xià ge yuè qù lǚxíng
wǒ měi ge yuè dōu hěn máng
explanation: 打算 (dǎsuàn) means “to plan to,” and 下个月 / 下個月 (xià ge yuè) means “next month.”

question: I take the bus to work every day
optionPinyin: wǒ zhōumò zài jiā zuò fàn
explanation: 每天 (měitiān) means “every day”; 坐公交车 / 坐公車 (zuò gōngjiāochē) means “take the bus.”

question: If we prepare in advance, we won't be so nervous
simplifiedOptions: 我们虽然很忙，但是很开心。
如果提前准备，就不会这么紧张。
traditionalOptions: 我們雖然很忙，但是很開心。
如果提前準備，就不會這麼緊張。
optionPinyin: wǒmen suīrán hěn máng, dànshì hěn kāixīn
wǒmen zhǔnbèi de bǐ zuótiān hǎo
rúguǒ tíqián zhǔnbèi, jiù bú huì zhème jǐnzhāng
explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) means “if,” and 就 (jiù) introduces the result. 提前 (tíqián) means “in advance.”

question: I prefer drinking tea
optionPinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì bēi shuǐ
explanation: 比较 / 比較 (bǐjiào) softens a comparison and here means “rather/prefer”; 喜欢 / 喜歡 (xǐhuan) means “like.”

question: This is my first time visiting China
optionPinyin: wǒ qùnián qù guo Zhōngguó liǎng cì
zhè shì wǒ dì-yī cì lái Zhōngguó
wǒ péngyou zhù zài Zhōngguó běifāng
explanation: 第一次 (dì-yī cì) means “the first time.” 来中国 / 來中國 (lái Zhōngguó) means “come to China.”

question: Thank you
explanation: 谢谢 / 謝謝 (xièxie) means “thank you.” 不客气 / 不客氣 (bú kèqi) is a common reply meaning “you're welcome.”

question: Three
explanation: 三 (sān) means “three.” The character is the same in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

question: I'd like a cup of tea.
explanation: 我要 (wǒ yào) means “I'd like” or “I want.” 一杯 (yì bēi) is a measure phrase for one cup or glass.

question: Where is the train station?
explanation: 火车站 / 火車站 (huǒchēzhàn) means “train station,” and 在哪里 / 在哪裡 (zài nǎlǐ) means “where is it?”

question: Tomorrow
explanation: 明天 (míngtiān) means “tomorrow.” 今天 (jīntiān) means “today,” and 昨天 (zuótiān) means “yesterday.”

question: I've been learning Chinese for two years.
optionPinyin: wǒ liǎng tiān qián kāishǐ xué Zhōngwén
wǒ xué Zhōngwén liǎng nián le
wǒ hái yào xué liǎng nián Zhōngwén
explanation: 我学中文两年了 / 我學中文兩年了 means “I've been learning Chinese for two years.” The 了 (le) marks the ongoing duration in this context.

question: Even though it was raining, we went out.
simplifiedOptions: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。
虽然下着雨，我们还是出去了。
traditionalOptions: 因為下雨，我們待在家裡。
雖然下著雨，我們還是出去了。
optionPinyin: yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen dāi zài jiālǐ
suīrán xiàzhe yǔ, wǒmen háishi chūqù le
wǒmen chūmén qián yǔ jiù tíng le
explanation: 虽然 / 雖然 (suīrán) means “although/even though.” 还是 / 還是 (háishi) here means “still” and signals that the action happened despite the rain.

question: Could you tell me how much this costs?
simplifiedOptions: 你能告诉我这是哪里制造的吗？
你能告诉我这个多少钱吗？
你能告诉我商店几点关门吗？
traditionalOptions: 你能告訴我這是哪裡製造的嗎？
你能告訴我這個多少錢嗎？
你能告訴我商店幾點關門嗎？
optionPinyin: nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zhè shì nǎlǐ zhìzào de ma
nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zhège duōshǎo qián ma
nǐ néng gàosu wǒ shāngdiàn jǐ diǎn guānmén ma
explanation: 这个多少钱 / 這個多少錢 (zhège duōshǎo qián) means “how much is this?” 你能告诉我 / 你能告訴我 (nǐ néng gàosu wǒ) means “could you tell me.”

question: The more I practise, the more confident I become.
simplifiedOptions: 我越有信心，练习就越少。
我练习得越多，就越有信心。
开始练习以前，我就很有信心。
traditionalOptions: 我越有信心，練習就越少。
我練習得越多，就越有信心。
開始練習以前，我就很有信心。
optionPinyin: wǒ yuè yǒu xìnxīn, liànxí jiù yuè shǎo
wǒ liànxí de yuè duō, jiù yuè yǒu xìnxīn
kāishǐ liànxí yǐqián, wǒ jiù hěn yǒu xìnxīn
explanation: 越……越…… (yuè…yuè…) expresses “the more…the more…” or “the …er…the …er.”

question: If I had known earlier, I would have told you.
simplifiedOptions: 我早就知道了，所以没告诉你。
如果我早点知道，就会告诉你了。
traditionalOptions: 我早就知道了，所以沒告訴你。
如果我早點知道，就會告訴你了。
optionPinyin: wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le, suǒyǐ méi gàosu nǐ
rúguǒ wǒ zǎodiǎn zhīdào, jiù huì gàosu nǐ le
wǒ yì zhīdào jiù huì gàosu nǐ
explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) means “if.” 早一点 / 早一點 (zǎodiǎn) means “a little earlier,” and 就会……了 / 就會……了 describes the result that would have followed.

question: My mother
explanation: 妈妈 / 媽媽 (māma) means “mother.” 我的 (wǒ de) means “my,” and 爸爸 (bàba) is “father.”

question: Not only is he smart, but he is also hard-working.
simplifiedOptions: 他不但聪明，而且很努力。
他虽然聪明，但是不努力。
只要他努力，就会很聪明。
traditionalOptions: 他不但聰明，而且很努力。
他雖然聰明，但是不努力。
只要他努力，就會很聰明。
optionPinyin: tā búdàn cōngmíng, érqiě hěn nǔlì
tā suīrán cōngmíng, dànshì bù nǔlì
zhǐyào tā nǔlì, jiù huì hěn cōngmíng
explanation: 不但……而且…… (búdàn…érqiě…) means “not only…but also…” and adds a second point on top of the first.

question: Good morning
explanation: 早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) means “good morning.” 晚安 (wǎn'ān) is “good night,” and 下午好 (xiàwǔ hǎo) is “good afternoon.”

question: Five
explanation: 五 (wǔ) means “five.” The character is the same in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

question: Sorry
explanation: 对不起 / 對不起 (duìbuqǐ) means “sorry.” 没关系 / 沒關係 (méi guānxi) is a common reply meaning “it doesn't matter,” and 请 / 請 (qǐng) means “please.”

question: My friend
explanation: 朋友 (péngyou) means “friend.” 老师 / 老師 (lǎoshī) is “teacher,” and 哥哥 (gēge) is “older brother.”

question: Water
explanation: 水 (shuǐ) means “water.” 茶 (chá) is “tea,” and 牛奶 (niúnǎi) is “milk.”

question: My name is Li Ming.
explanation: 我叫 (wǒ jiào) means “my name is” (literally “I am called”). 我是老师 / 我是老師 means “I am a teacher,” and 我很好 means “I'm fine.”

question: Red
explanation: 红色 / 紅色 (hóngsè) means “red.” 蓝色 / 藍色 (lánsè) is “blue,” and 绿色 / 綠色 (lǜsè) is “green.”

question: I am a student.
explanation: 学生 / 學生 (xuésheng) means “student.” 医生 / 醫生 (yīshēng) is “doctor,” and 老师 / 老師 (lǎoshī) is “teacher.”

question: It's very hot today.
explanation: 热 / 熱 (rè) means “hot,” while 冷 (lěng) means “cold.” 下雨 (xiàyǔ) means “to rain.”

question: What time is it?
explanation: 现在 / 現在 (xiànzài) means “now,” and 几点 / 幾點 (jǐ diǎn) means “what time.” 几号 / 幾號 asks for the date, and 几岁 / 幾歲 asks for someone's age.

question: It's too expensive.
explanation: 太……了 (tài…le) means “too…”. 贵 / 貴 (guì) means “expensive,” while 便宜 (piányi) means “cheap.”

question: I have a headache.
explanation: 头疼 / 頭疼 (tóu téng) means “headache” (literally “head hurts”). 肚子饿 / 肚子餓 (dùzi è) means “hungry,” and 困 / 睏 (kùn) means “sleepy.”

question: I like watching movies.
explanation: 看电影 / 看電影 (kàn diànyǐng) means “watch a movie.” 听音乐 / 聽音樂 means “listen to music,” and 做饭 / 做飯 means “cook.”

question: Turn left at the corner.
explanation: 往左拐 (wǎng zuǒ guǎi) means “turn left.” 右 (yòu) is “right,” and 一直往前走 (yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu) means “go straight ahead.”

question: I work in a hospital.
explanation: 在 (zài) marks the location, 医院 / 醫院 (yīyuàn) means “hospital,” and 工作 (gōngzuò) means “to work.”

question: The food here is delicious.
explanation: 好吃 (hǎochī) means “tasty,” and 菜 (cài) here means “dishes” or “food.” 人很多 means “lots of people,” and 房间 / 房間 means “room.”

question: I have never eaten Peking duck.
simplifiedOptions: 我从来没吃过北京烤鸭。
traditionalOptions: 我從來沒吃過北京烤鴨。
optionPinyin: wǒ chī guo liǎng cì Běijīng kǎoyā
wǒ cónglái méi chī guo Běijīng kǎoyā
explanation: 从来没……过 / 從來沒……過 (cónglái méi…guo) means “have never…”. 过 / 過 (guo) marks a past experience.

question: You should rest more.
explanation: 应该 / 應該 (yīnggāi) means “should,” and 多 (duō) before a verb means “more.” 不应该 / 不應該 would mean “shouldn't.”

question: This phone is cheaper than that one.
simplifiedOptions: 这个手机和那个一样贵。
traditionalOptions: 這個手機和那個一樣貴。
optionPinyin: zhège shǒujī hé nàge yíyàng guì
explanation: The pattern A 比 (bǐ) B + adjective means “A is more … than B.” Here 这个 / 這個 (this one) is the cheaper phone.

question: I'm going to the airport to pick up a friend.
explanation: 接 (jiē) means “to pick up” or “to meet” someone. 去机场接朋友 / 去機場接朋友 chains two verbs: go to the airport, then pick up a friend.

question: I agree with you.
optionPinyin: wǒ bù tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ
wǒ méi tīngdǒng nǐ de huà
explanation: 同意 (tóngyì) means “to agree,” and 看法 (kànfǎ) means “opinion” or “view.” Adding 不 (bù) reverses the meaning to “disagree.”

question: I've been waiting for you for half an hour.
simplifiedOptions: 我每半个小时给你打电话。
traditionalOptions: 我每半個小時給你打電話。
optionPinyin: wǒ bàn ge xiǎoshí hòu qù zhǎo nǐ
wǒ měi bàn ge xiǎoshí gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà
wǒ děng le nǐ bàn ge xiǎoshí le
explanation: Verb + 了 + duration expresses how long something has lasted: 等了半个小时 / 等了半個小時 means “waited for half an hour.” 后 / 後 means “after,” and 每 means “every.”

question: I forgot to bring my umbrella.
explanation: 忘了 (wàng le) means “forgot,” and 带 / 帶 (dài) means “to bring.” 雨伞 / 雨傘 (yǔsǎn) is “umbrella.”

question: As soon as I got home, it started to rain.
simplifiedOptions: 我回家以后，雨一直没下。
因为到家了，所以下雨了。
traditionalOptions: 我回家以後，雨一直沒下。
因為到家了，所以下雨了。
optionPinyin: wǒ yí dào jiā, jiù xiàyǔ le
wǒ huí jiā yǐhòu, yǔ yìzhí méi xià
yīnwèi dào jiā le, suǒyǐ xiàyǔ le
explanation: 一……就…… (yī…jiù…) means “as soon as…, then…”. It links two actions that happen in quick succession.

question: Unless you practise more, you won't improve.
simplifiedOptions: 即使你不练习，也会进步。
只要你练习，就一定会进步。
除非你多练习，否则不会进步。
traditionalOptions: 即使你不練習，也會進步。
只要你練習，就一定會進步。
除非你多練習，否則不會進步。
optionPinyin: jíshǐ nǐ bù liànxí, yě huì jìnbù
zhǐyào nǐ liànxí, jiù yídìng huì jìnbù
chúfēi nǐ duō liànxí, fǒuzé bú huì jìnbù
explanation: 除非……否则…… / 除非……否則…… (chúfēi…fǒuzé…) means “unless…, otherwise…”. 只要……就…… means “as long as…,” and 即使……也…… means “even if…”.

question: He was criticised by the teacher.
explanation: 被 (bèi) marks the passive voice: subject + 被 + agent + verb. 他被老师批评了 / 他被老師批評了 means “he was criticised by the teacher.”

question: Please put the book on the table.
optionPinyin: qǐng bǎ zhuōzi fàng zài shū shàng
qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng
qǐng zài zhuōzi shàng kàn shū
explanation: 把 (bǎ) moves the object before the verb to show what is being handled: 把书放在桌子上 / 把書放在桌子上 means “put the book on the table.”

question: Even if it's difficult, I won't give up.
simplifiedOptions: 因为很难，所以我放弃了。
即使很难，我也不会放弃。
traditionalOptions: 因為很難，所以我放棄了。
即使很難，我也不會放棄。
optionPinyin: yīnwèi hěn nán, suǒyǐ wǒ fàngqì le
rúguǒ bù nán, wǒ jiù bú fàngqì
jíshǐ hěn nán, wǒ yě bú huì fàngqì
explanation: 即使……也…… (jíshǐ…yě…) means “even if…, still…”. 放弃 / 放棄 (fàngqì) means “to give up.”

question: He speaks Chinese as fluently as a Chinese person.
simplifiedOptions: 他说中文说得比中国人流利。
他说中文说得跟中国人一样流利。
他说中文说得不如中国人流利。
traditionalOptions: 他說中文說得比中國人流利。
他說中文說得跟中國人一樣流利。
他說中文說得不如中國人流利。
optionPinyin: tā shuō Zhōngwén shuō de bǐ Zhōngguórén liúlì
tā shuō Zhōngwén shuō de gēn Zhōngguórén yíyàng liúlì
tā shuō Zhōngwén shuō de bùrú Zhōngguórén liúlì
explanation: 跟……一样 / 跟……一樣 (gēn…yíyàng) means “the same as…”. 比 (bǐ) means “more than,” and 不如 (bùrú) means “not as good as.”

question: It's not that I don't want to go; I just don't have time.
simplifiedOptions: 我想去，所以我没有时间。
不是我不想去，而是我没有时间。
我不想去，因为我有时间。
traditionalOptions: 我想去，所以我沒有時間。
不是我不想去，而是我沒有時間。
我不想去，因為我有時間。
optionPinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān
búshì wǒ bù xiǎng qù, érshì wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān
wǒ bù xiǎng qù, yīnwèi wǒ yǒu shíjiān
explanation: 不是……而是…… (búshì…érshì…) means “it's not that…, rather…”. It corrects a possible misunderstanding by giving the real reason.

question: Dog
explanation: 狗 (gǒu) means “dog.” 猫 / 貓 (māo) is “cat,” and 鸟 / 鳥 (niǎo) is “bird.”

question: My younger sister
explanation: 妹妹 (mèimei) means “younger sister.” 姐姐 (jiějie) is “older sister,” and 奶奶 (nǎinai) is “grandmother” (father's side).

question: Ten
explanation: 十 (shí) means “ten.” 八 (bā) is “eight,” and 九 (jiǔ) is “nine.” The characters are the same in both scripts.

question: Rice (cooked)
explanation: 米饭 / 米飯 (mǐfàn) means “cooked rice.” 面条 / 麵條 (miàntiáo) is “noodles,” and 面包 / 麵包 (miànbāo) is “bread.”

question: See you tomorrow.
explanation: 见 / 見 (jiàn) means “to see,” so 明天见 / 明天見 literally means “see (you) tomorrow.” 请坐 / 請坐 means “please sit down.”

question: I'm hungry.
explanation: 饿 / 餓 (è) means “hungry.” 渴 (kě) is “thirsty,” and 累 (lèi) is “tired.” The 了 (le) shows a change of state.

question: This is my home.
explanation: 家 (jiā) means “home” or “family.” 学校 / 學校 (xuéxiào) is “school,” and 书 / 書 (shū) is “book.”

question: How are you?
explanation: 你好吗 / 你好嗎 (nǐ hǎo ma) means “how are you?” 谁 / 誰 (shéi) means “who,” and 哪儿 / 哪兒 (nǎr) means “where.”

question: I go to school by subway.
explanation: 坐地铁 / 坐地鐵 (zuò dìtiě) means “take the subway.” 骑自行车 / 騎自行車 (qí zìxíngchē) is “ride a bicycle,” and 走路 (zǒulù) is “walk.”

question: I want to buy a pair of shoes.
optionPinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn yīfu
wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng xié
wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì dǐng màozi
explanation: 双 / 雙 (shuāng) is the measure word for pairs, and 鞋 (xié) means “shoes.” 件 (jiàn) is used for clothes, and 顶 / 頂 (dǐng) for hats.

question: The exam is tomorrow.
explanation: 考试 / 考試 (kǎoshì) means “exam,” and 明天 (míngtiān) means “tomorrow.” 放假 (fàngjià) means “to have a holiday.”

question: The bill, please.
optionPinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ
explanation: 买单 / 買單 (mǎidān) is a common way to ask for the bill or to say you'll pay. 菜单 / 菜單 (càidān) means “menu.”

question: I have a cold.
explanation: 感冒 (gǎnmào) means “to catch a cold.” 迟到 / 遲到 (chídào) means “to be late,” and 搬家 (bānjiā) means “to move house.”

question: It will rain tomorrow.
explanation: 会 / 會 (huì) here expresses a prediction about the future, “will.” 昨天 (zuótiān) means “yesterday,” and 热 / 熱 (rè) means “hot.”

question: I often play basketball on weekends.
optionPinyin: wǒ píngshí hěn shǎo dǎ lánqiú
explanation: 常常 (chángcháng) means “often,” and 周末 / 週末 (zhōumò) means “weekend.” 打篮球 / 打籃球 (dǎ lánqiú) means “play basketball.”

question: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
simplifiedOptions: 我想订一间房，住两个晚上。
traditionalOptions: 我想訂一間房，住兩個晚上。
optionPinyin: wǒ xiǎng dìng yì jiān fáng, zhù liǎng ge wǎnshang
wǒ xiǎng dìng liǎng zhāng huǒchēpiào
explanation: 订 / 訂 (dìng) means “to book,” and 间 / 間 (jiān) is the measure word for rooms. 退房 (tuìfáng) means “to check out.”

question: My phone has run out of battery.
optionPinyin: wǒ de shǒujī méi diàn le
explanation: 没电 / 沒電 (méi diàn) literally means “no electricity,” i.e. out of battery. 丢 / 丟 (diū) means “lost,” and 坏 / 壞 (huài) means “broken.”

question: I'm a little nervous about the interview.
explanation: 对……紧张 / 對……緊張 (duì…jǐnzhāng) means “nervous about…”. 有点儿 / 有點兒 (yǒudiǎnr) means “a little” and often carries a slightly negative feeling.

question: Could you speak a bit more slowly?
explanation: Verb + adjective + 一点儿 / 一點兒 (yìdiǎnr) softens a request: 说慢一点儿 means “speak a bit slower.” 写下来 / 寫下來 means “write it down.”

question: I used to live in Shanghai.
explanation: 以前 (yǐqián) means “before” or “in the past.” 现在 / 現在 (xiànzài) means “now,” and 打算 (dǎsuàn) means “plan to.”

question: I usually get up at seven o'clock.
optionPinyin: wǒ zuótiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng le
explanation: 通常 (tōngcháng) means “usually,” and 起床 (qǐchuáng) means “to get up.” 睡觉 / 睡覺 (shuìjiào) means “to sleep.”

question: The doctor told me to drink more water.
optionPinyin: yīshēng ràng wǒ shǎo hē shuǐ
yīshēng ràng wǒ duō hē shuǐ
yīshēng ràng wǒ duō chī yào
explanation: 让 / 讓 (ràng) here means “to tell (someone) to.” 多 (duō) means “more” and 少 (shǎo) means “less” before a verb.

question: I like staying at home more.
optionPinyin: wǒ hěn shǎo dāi zài jiālǐ
wǒ gèng xǐhuan dāi zài jiālǐ
explanation: 更 (gèng) means “even more” or “more” in comparisons, and 待 (dāi) means “to stay.” 出去玩 (chūqù wán) means “go out and have fun.”

question: Because of the traffic jam, we were late.
simplifiedOptions: 虽然堵车，我们还是准时到了。
只要不堵车，我们就不会迟到。
traditionalOptions: 雖然堵車，我們還是準時到了。
只要不堵車，我們就不會遲到。
optionPinyin: suīrán dǔchē, wǒmen háishi zhǔnshí dào le
zhǐyào bù dǔchē, wǒmen jiù bú huì chídào
explanation: 由于 / 由於 (yóuyú) means “because of” or “due to,” and is a somewhat formal way to give a cause.

question: No matter how busy he is, he always keeps exercising.
simplifiedOptions: 无论多忙，他都坚持锻炼。
因为很忙，所以他才锻炼。
traditionalOptions: 無論多忙，他都堅持鍛煉。
因為很忙，所以他才鍛煉。
optionPinyin: rúguǒ hěn máng, tā jiù bù duànliàn
wúlùn duō máng, tā dōu jiānchí duànliàn
yīnwèi hěn máng, suǒyǐ tā cái duànliàn
explanation: 无论……都…… / 無論……都…… (wúlùn…dōu…) means “no matter…, (always)…”. 坚持 / 堅持 (jiānchí) means “to persist.”

question: He seems a bit unhappy today.
optionPinyin: tā jīntiān hǎoxiàng bú tài gāoxìng
tā jīntiān yǐjīng hěn gāoxìng le
explanation: 好像 (hǎoxiàng) means “seems” or “looks as if.” 终于 / 終於 (zhōngyú) means “finally,” and 不太 (bú tài) means “not very.”

question: It is said that this restaurant is very famous.
simplifiedOptions: 他告诉我这家餐厅关门了。
traditionalOptions: 他告訴我這家餐廳關門了。
optionPinyin: tā gàosu wǒ zhè jiā cāntīng guānmén le
zhè jiā cāntīng bǐ nà jiā yǒumíng
jùshuō zhè jiā cāntīng hěn yǒumíng
explanation: 据说 / 據說 (jùshuō) means “it is said that,” and is used to report hearsay. 有名 (yǒumíng) means “famous.”

question: He left without even saying goodbye.
simplifiedOptions: 他连再见都没说就走了。
traditionalOptions: 他連再見都沒說就走了。
optionPinyin: tā shuō le zàijiàn cái zǒu
tā lián zàijiàn dōu méi shuō jiù zǒu le
tā zǒu le yǐhòu cái shuō zàijiàn
explanation: 连……都…… / 連……都…… (lián…dōu…) means “even…”. With 没 / 沒 it gives “didn't even…”, stressing how minimal the omitted action was.

question: In order to pass the exam, she studies every night.
simplifiedOptions: 因为通过了考试，她每天晚上都学习。
通过考试以后，她每天晚上都学习。
为了通过考试，她每天晚上都学习。
traditionalOptions: 因為通過了考試，她每天晚上都學習。
通過考試以後，她每天晚上都學習。
為了通過考試，她每天晚上都學習。
optionPinyin: yīnwèi tōngguò le kǎoshì, tā měitiān wǎnshang dōu xuéxí
tōngguò kǎoshì yǐhòu, tā měitiān wǎnshang dōu xuéxí
wèile tōngguò kǎoshì, tā měitiān wǎnshang dōu xuéxí
explanation: 为了 / 為了 (wèile) means “in order to” or “for the sake of,” and introduces a purpose. 通过 / 通過 (tōngguò) means “to pass.”

question: Not only did he not help, he actually made things worse.
simplifiedOptions: 他不但帮了忙，而且帮了很多。
他不但没帮忙，反而添了麻烦。
他虽然帮了忙，但是还是添了麻烦。
traditionalOptions: 他不但幫了忙，而且幫了很多。
他不但沒幫忙，反而添了麻煩。
他雖然幫了忙，但是還是添了麻煩。
optionPinyin: tā búdàn bāng le máng, érqiě bāng le hěn duō
tā búdàn méi bāngmáng, fǎn'ér tiān le máfan
tā suīrán bāng le máng, dànshì háishi tiān le máfan
explanation: 不但没……反而…… / 不但沒……反而…… (búdàn méi…fǎn'ér…) means “not only didn't…, but on the contrary…”. 添麻烦 / 添麻煩 (tiān máfan) means “to cause trouble.”

question: Eyes
explanation: 眼睛 (yǎnjing) means “eyes.” 耳朵 (ěrduo) is “ears,” and 嘴巴 (zuǐba) is “mouth.”

question: Twenty
explanation: 二十 (èrshí) means “twenty” (literally “two-ten”). 十二 (shí'èr) is “twelve,” and 三十 (sānshí) is “thirty.”

question: He is a teacher.
explanation: 老师 / 老師 (lǎoshī) means “teacher.” 警察 (jǐngchá) is “police officer,” and 司机 / 司機 (sījī) is “driver.”

question: Today is Monday.
explanation: 星期 (xīngqī) means “week,” and the days are numbered: 星期一 is Monday, 星期五 is Friday. 星期天 (xīngqītiān) is Sunday.

question: Apple
explanation: 苹果 / 蘋果 (píngguǒ) means “apple.” 香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) is “banana,” and 西瓜 (xīguā) is “watermelon.”

question: Where is the toilet?
explanation: 洗手间 / 洗手間 (xǐshǒujiān) means “restroom” (literally “hand-washing room”). 在哪里 / 在哪裡 (zài nǎlǐ) means “where is…?”

question: I don't know.
explanation: 知道 (zhīdào) means “to know,” and 不 (bù) negates it: 不知道 means “don't know.” 不想去 means “don't want to go.”

question: I like spring the most.
explanation: 最 (zuì) means “most.” 春天 (chūntiān) is “spring,” 夏天 (xiàtiān) is “summer,” and 冬天 (dōngtiān) is “winter.”

question: My birthday is in May.
optionPinyin: wǒ de shēngrì zài sān yuè
wǒ de shēngrì zài bā yuè
wǒ de shēngrì zài wǔ yuè
explanation: Months are formed with number + 月 (yuè): 三月 is March, 五月 is May, and 八月 is August.

question: There is a TV in the living room.
optionPinyin: kètīng lǐ yǒu yì tái diànshì
chúfáng lǐ yǒu yì zhāng chuáng
wòshì lǐ yǒu yì zhāng zhuōzi
explanation: Place + 有 (yǒu) + thing means “there is…”. 客厅 / 客廳 is “living room,” 厨房 / 廚房 is “kitchen,” and 卧室 / 臥室 is “bedroom.”

question: He can swim.
explanation: 会 / 會 (huì) means “can” in the sense of having learned a skill. 游泳 (yóuyǒng) means “to swim,” and 跑步 (pǎobù) means “to run.”

question: Please wait a moment.
explanation: 等一下 (děng yíxià) means “wait a moment”; 一下 softens the verb. 请坐下 / 請坐下 means “please sit down,” and 请进 / 請進 means “please come in.”

question: Do you have a smaller one?
explanation: 小一点儿 / 小一點兒 (xiǎo yìdiǎnr) means “a bit smaller,” and 的 (de) turns it into a noun phrase, “a smaller one.” 大 means “bigger.”

question: The bus is late.
explanation: 晚点 / 晚點 (wǎndiǎn) means “to be late” or “delayed,” used for buses, trains and flights. 早 (zǎo) means “early.”

question: I brush my teeth every morning.
explanation: 刷牙 (shuā yá) means “to brush one's teeth,” and 洗澡 (xǐzǎo) means “to take a bath or shower.” 早上 means “morning.”

question: I'm planning to learn to drive next year.
explanation: 打算 (dǎsuàn) means “to plan to,” and 明年 (míngnián) means “next year.” 学会 / 學會 (xuéhuì) means “to have learned (how to).”

question: I think this film is boring.
simplifiedOptions: 我觉得这部电影很有意思。
我觉得这部电影很没意思。
traditionalOptions: 我覺得這部電影很有意思。
我覺得這部電影很沒意思。
optionPinyin: wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒu yìsi
wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn méi yìsi
wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn cháng
explanation: 有意思 (yǒu yìsi) means “interesting,” and 没意思 / 沒意思 (méi yìsi) means “boring.” 部 (bù) is the measure word for films.

question: Shanghai isn't as cold as Beijing.
explanation: A 没有 / 沒有 B + adjective means “A is not as … as B.” 比 (bǐ) means “more than,” and 一样 / 一樣 (yíyàng) means “the same.”

question: I've been to the Great Wall twice.
optionPinyin: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì Chángchéng
wǒ xiǎng qù liǎng cì Chángchéng
explanation: 过 / 過 (guo) marks a past experience, and 两次 / 兩次 (liǎng cì) means “twice.” The frequency phrase comes after the verb.

question: I was very surprised to hear the news.
simplifiedOptions: 听到这个消息，我很伤心。
听到这个消息，我很高兴。
听到这个消息，我很吃惊。
traditionalOptions: 聽到這個消息，我很傷心。
聽到這個消息，我很高興。
聽到這個消息，我很吃驚。
optionPinyin: tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ hěn shāngxīn
tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ hěn gāoxìng
tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ hěn chījīng
explanation: 吃惊 / 吃驚 (chījīng) means “surprised.” 伤心 / 傷心 (shāngxīn) means “sad,” and 高兴 / 高興 (gāoxìng) means “happy.”

question: I have a meeting at three o'clock this afternoon.
optionPinyin: wǒ zuótiān xiàwǔ kāi le ge huì
wǒ xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǒu ge huìyì
wǒ xiàwǔ sān diǎn yào huí jiā
explanation: 会议 / 會議 (huìyì) means “meeting,” and 下午三点 / 下午三點 means “three o'clock in the afternoon.” 开会 / 開會 means “to hold or attend a meeting.”

question: You must wear a seat belt.
explanation: 必须 / 必須 (bìxū) means “must.” 不用 (búyòng) means “don't need to,” and 可以不 means “may choose not to.”

question: Excuse me, may I ask you a question?
simplifiedOptions: 请问，我可以问你一个问题吗？
traditionalOptions: 請問，我可以問你一個問題嗎？
optionPinyin: qǐngwèn, wǒ kěyǐ wèn nǐ yí ge wèntí ma?
duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù néng wèn nǐ
xièxie, wǒ yǐjīng wèn guo le
explanation: 请问 / 請問 (qǐngwèn) is a polite opener meaning “excuse me, may I ask…”. 问问题 / 問問題 means “to ask a question.”

question: Since you're already here, stay and have dinner.
simplifiedOptions: 虽然你来了，但是不能吃饭。
既然你来了，就留下来吃饭吧。
traditionalOptions: 雖然你來了，但是不能吃飯。
既然你來了，就留下來吃飯吧。
optionPinyin: suīrán nǐ lái le, dànshì bù néng chīfàn
jìrán nǐ lái le, jiù liú xiàlái chīfàn ba
zhǐyǒu nǐ lái le, wǒ cái chīfàn
explanation: 既然……就…… (jìrán…jiù…) means “since…, then…”. It draws a conclusion from a fact that is already true.

question: Only if you work hard can you succeed.
optionPinyin: jíshǐ nǔlì, yě bù néng chénggōng
explanation: 只有……才…… (zhǐyǒu…cái…) means “only if…, then…” and states a necessary condition. 只要……就…… means “as long as…,” a sufficient condition.

question: He was so tired that he couldn't even open his eyes.
simplifiedOptions: 他累得眼睛都睁不开了。
traditionalOptions: 他累得眼睛都睜不開了。
optionPinyin: tā lèi de yǎnjing dōu zhēng bù kāi le
tā lèi le suǒyǐ zhēngkāi yǎnjing
tā bú lèi, yǎnjing zhēng de hěn dà
explanation: Adjective + 得 (de) + result means “so … that …”. 睁不开 / 睜不開 (zhēng bù kāi) is a potential complement meaning “unable to open.”

question: The meeting was postponed until next week.
optionPinyin: huìyì bèi tíqián dào xiàzhōu le
huìyì bèi tuīchí dào xiàzhōu le
explanation: 推迟 / 推遲 (tuīchí) means “to postpone,” and 提前 (tíqián) means “to bring forward.” 被 (bèi) marks the passive: the meeting was postponed.

question: He would rather walk than trouble other people.
simplifiedOptions: 他宁可麻烦别人，也不愿意自己走路。
他不但走路，而且麻烦别人。
他宁可自己走路，也不愿意麻烦别人。
traditionalOptions: 他寧可麻煩別人，也不願意自己走路。
他不但走路，而且麻煩別人。
他寧可自己走路，也不願意麻煩別人。
optionPinyin: tā nìngkě máfan biérén, yě bú yuànyì zìjǐ zǒulù
tā búdàn zǒulù, érqiě máfan biérén
tā nìngkě zìjǐ zǒulù, yě bú yuànyì máfan biérén
explanation: 宁可……也不…… / 寧可……也不…… (nìngkě…yě bù…) means “would rather…than…”. What follows 宁可 is the preferred choice.

question: I never expected it to snow even in April.
optionPinyin: méi xiǎngdào sìyuè hái huì xiàxuě
explanation: 没想到 / 沒想到 (méi xiǎngdào) means “didn't expect (that)…” and expresses surprise. 当然 / 當然 (dāngrán) means “of course.”

question: As for this issue, I have no idea at all.
simplifiedOptions: 关于这个问题，我一点儿也不清楚。
关于这个问题，我已经解决了。
对这个问题，我已经很清楚了。
traditionalOptions: 關於這個問題，我一點兒也不清楚。
關於這個問題，我已經解決了。
對這個問題，我已經很清楚了。
optionPinyin: guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ yìdiǎnr yě bù qīngchu
guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ yǐjīng jiějué le
duì zhège wèntí, wǒ yǐjīng hěn qīngchu le
explanation: 关于 / 關於 (guānyú) means “regarding.” 一点儿也不 / 一點兒也不 (yìdiǎnr yě bù) means “not at all” and adds strong negative emphasis.

question: Skirt
explanation: 裙子 (qúnzi) means “skirt.” 裤子 / 褲子 (kùzi) is “trousers,” and 帽子 (màozi) is “hat.”

question: Coffee
explanation: 咖啡 (kāfēi) means “coffee.” 牛奶 (niúnǎi) is “milk,” and 果汁 (guǒzhī) is “fruit juice.”

question: Welcome!
explanation: 欢迎 / 歡迎 (huānyíng) means “welcome.” 晚安 (wǎn'ān) is “good night,” and 再见 / 再見 (zàijiàn) is “goodbye.”

question: One hundred
explanation: 一百 (yì bǎi) means “one hundred.” 一千 (yì qiān) is “one thousand,” and 十 (shí) is “ten.”

question: My older brother
explanation: 哥哥 (gēge) means “older brother.” 弟弟 (dìdi) is “younger brother,” and 爸爸 (bàba) is “dad.”

question: I like cats.
explanation: 喜欢 / 喜歡 (xǐhuan) means “to like.” 猫 / 貓 (māo) is “cat,” 狗 (gǒu) is “dog,” and 鸟 / 鳥 (niǎo) is “bird.”

question: I'm going to the supermarket.
explanation: 去 (qù) means “to go,” and 超市 (chāoshì) means “supermarket.” 学校 / 學校 is “school,” and 医院 / 醫院 is “hospital.”

question: How much is it?
explanation: 多少钱 / 多少錢 (duōshao qián) means “how much (money)?” 几点 / 幾點 asks “what time,” and 几岁 / 幾歲 asks “how old.”

question: I'm very happy to see you.
explanation: 见到 / 見到 (jiàndào) means “to see” or “to meet,” and 高兴 / 高興 (gāoxìng) means “happy.” 生气 / 生氣 (shēngqì) means “angry.”

question: The bank is next to the post office.
explanation: 旁边 / 旁邊 (pángbiān) means “next to.” 对面 / 對面 (duìmiàn) means “opposite,” and 后面 / 後面 (hòumiàn) means “behind.”

question: She plays the piano very well.
optionPinyin: tā gāngqín tán de hěn hǎo
tā gāngqín tán de bù hǎo
explanation: Verb + 得 (de) + adjective describes how well something is done: 弹得很好 / 彈得很好 means “plays very well.”

question: I eat dinner at seven o'clock.
explanation: 晚饭 / 晚飯 (wǎnfàn) means “dinner.” 早饭 / 早飯 (zǎofàn) is “breakfast,” and 午饭 / 午飯 (wǔfàn) is “lunch.”

question: I need to see a doctor.
explanation: 看医生 / 看醫生 (kàn yīshēng) means “to see a doctor” (literally “look at a doctor”). 看 (kàn) is also used in “watch a movie” and “visit a friend.”

question: It's snowing.
explanation: 下雪 (xiàxuě) means “to snow.” 刮风 / 刮風 (guāfēng) means “it's windy,” and 出太阳 / 出太陽 (chū tàiyáng) means “the sun comes out.”

question: I don't eat meat.
explanation: 肉 (ròu) means “meat.” 酒 (jiǔ) means “alcohol,” and 辣 (là) means “spicy.” The characters are the same in both scripts.

question: My computer is broken and needs to be repaired.
simplifiedOptions: 我的电脑很新，不用修理。
我的电脑坏了，需要修理。
traditionalOptions: 我的電腦很新，不用修理。
我的電腦壞了，需要修理。
optionPinyin: wǒ de diànnǎo hěn xīn, búyòng xiūlǐ
wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì tái xīn diànnǎo
wǒ de diànnǎo huài le, xūyào xiūlǐ
explanation: 坏了 / 壞了 (huài le) means “broken,” 需要 (xūyào) means “need,” and 修理 (xiūlǐ) means “to repair.”

question: We should protect the environment.
explanation: 保护 / 保護 (bǎohù) means “to protect,” and 环境 / 環境 (huánjìng) means “environment.” 塑料袋 / 塑膠袋 (sùliàodài) means “plastic bag.”

question: I haven't seen him for a long time.
optionPinyin: wǒ hěn jiǔ méi jiàndào tā le
explanation: 很久没……了 / 很久沒……了 (hěn jiǔ méi…le) means “haven't … for a long time.” 昨天 means “yesterday,” and 常常 means “often.”

question: I was late because I missed the bus.
simplifiedOptions: 我赶上了公交车，所以迟到了。
我没赶上公交车，所以迟到了。
我迟到了，所以没赶上公交车。
traditionalOptions: 我趕上了公車，所以遲到了。
我沒趕上公車，所以遲到了。
我遲到了，所以沒趕上公車。
optionPinyin: wǒ gǎn shàng le gōngjiāochē, suǒyǐ chídào le
wǒ méi gǎn shàng gōngjiāochē, suǒyǐ chídào le
wǒ chídào le, suǒyǐ méi gǎn shàng gōngjiāochē
explanation: 赶上 / 趕上 (gǎn shàng) means “to catch” a bus or train, so 没赶上 / 沒趕上 means “missed it.” 所以 (suǒyǐ) introduces the result, so the cause must come first.

question: I'm very interested in Chinese history.
simplifiedOptions: 我对中国历史不感兴趣。
我去过中国历史博物馆。
我对中国历史很感兴趣。
traditionalOptions: 我對中國歷史不感興趣。
我去過中國歷史博物館。
我對中國歷史很感興趣。
optionPinyin: wǒ duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ bù gǎn xìngqù
wǒ qù guo Zhōngguó lìshǐ bówùguǎn
wǒ duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ hěn gǎn xìngqù
explanation: 对……感兴趣 / 對……感興趣 (duì…gǎn xìngqù) means “to be interested in…”. Adding 不 makes it “not interested.”

question: During the Spring Festival, families get together.
simplifiedOptions: 春节的时候，一家人会团聚。
春节的时候，大家都去上班。
traditionalOptions: 春節的時候，一家人會團聚。
春節的時候，大家都去上班。
optionPinyin: Chūnjié de shíhou, yì jiā rén huì tuánjù
Chūnjié de shíhou, dàjiā dōu qù shàngbān
Chūnjié de shíhou, tiānqì hěn rè
explanation: 春节 / 春節 (Chūnjié) is the Spring Festival (Chinese New Year), and 团聚 / 團聚 (tuánjù) means “to reunite.” 一家人 means “the whole family.”

question: Would you mind opening the window?
optionPinyin: nǐ jièyì guān yíxià mén ma
nǐ jièyì kāi yíxià chuānghu ma
nǐ néng bāng wǒ mǎi chuānghu ma
explanation: 介意 (jièyì) means “to mind,” 开 / 開 means “to open,” and 关 / 關 means “to close.” 窗户 / 窗戶 (chuānghu) means “window.”

question: Rather than complain, it's better to take action.
optionPinyin: jìrán bàoyuàn, jiù bú yào xíngdòng
explanation: 与其……不如…… / 與其……不如…… (yǔqí…bùrú…) means “rather than…, it's better to…”. The second part is the preferred option.

question: Just in case it rains, take an umbrella.
simplifiedOptions: 如果下雨了，我们就回家了。
虽然下雨，我们还是出去了。
traditionalOptions: 如果下雨了，我們就回家了。
雖然下雨，我們還是出去了。
optionPinyin: rúguǒ xiàyǔ le, wǒmen jiù huí jiā le
suīrán xiàyǔ, wǒmen háishi chūqù le
wànyī xiàyǔ, jiù dài bǎ sǎn ba
explanation: 万一 / 萬一 (wànyī) means “in case” or “if by chance,” and is used for an unlikely event that you prepare for. 把 (bǎ) here is a measure word for umbrellas.

question: He broke my cup.
simplifiedOptions: 他把杯子放在桌子上了。
traditionalOptions: 他把杯子放在桌子上了。
optionPinyin: tā de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎsuì le
tā bǎ wǒ de bēizi dǎsuì le
tā bǎ bēizi fàng zài zhuōzi shàng le
explanation: 把 + object + verb + result describes what someone did to the object: 打碎了 (dǎsuì le) means “smashed.” The first option reverses the roles: “his cup was broken by me.”

question: No wonder he's so tired; it turns out he worked all night.
simplifiedOptions: 他这么累，因为他睡了一整夜。
他虽然累，但是还在工作。
难怪他这么累，原来他工作了一整夜。
traditionalOptions: 他這麼累，因為他睡了一整夜。
他雖然累，但是還在工作。
難怪他這麼累，原來他工作了一整夜。
optionPinyin: tā zhème lèi, yīnwèi tā shuì le yì zhěng yè
tā suīrán lèi, dànshì hái zài gōngzuò
nánguài tā zhème lèi, yuánlái tā gōngzuò le yì zhěng yè
explanation: 难怪 / 難怪 (nánguài) means “no wonder,” and 原来 / 原來 (yuánlái) means “it turns out.” Together they show a puzzle being explained.

question: Once you form a habit, it's hard to change.
simplifiedOptions: 一旦养成习惯，就很难改变。
如果没有习惯，就很难改变。
只要养成习惯，就不用改变。
traditionalOptions: 一旦養成習慣，就很難改變。
如果沒有習慣，就很難改變。
只要養成習慣，就不用改變。
optionPinyin: yídàn yǎngchéng xíguàn, jiù hěn nán gǎibiàn
rúguǒ méiyǒu xíguàn, jiù hěn nán gǎibiàn
zhǐyào yǎngchéng xíguàn, jiù búyòng gǎibiàn
explanation: 一旦……就…… (yídàn…jiù…) means “once…, then…”. 养成 / 養成 (yǎngchéng) means “to form” (a habit).

question: Compared with the past, life is much better now.
simplifiedOptions: 与现在相比，过去的生活好多了。
与过去相比，现在的生活好多了。
现在的生活跟过去一样好。
traditionalOptions: 與現在相比，過去的生活好多了。
與過去相比，現在的生活好多了。
現在的生活跟過去一樣好。
optionPinyin: yǔ xiànzài xiāngbǐ, guòqù de shēnghuó hǎo duō le
yǔ guòqù xiāngbǐ, xiànzài de shēnghuó hǎo duō le
xiànzài de shēnghuó gēn guòqù yíyàng hǎo
explanation: 与……相比 / 與……相比 (yǔ…xiāngbǐ) means “compared with…”. The thing after 与 / 與 is the baseline, and 好多了 means “much better.”

question: You'd better leave now, otherwise you'll miss the train.
simplifiedOptions: 你最好现在出发，所以会错过火车。
你最好现在出发，虽然会错过火车。
你最好现在出发，否则会错过火车。
traditionalOptions: 你最好現在出發，所以會錯過火車。
你最好現在出發，雖然會錯過火車。
你最好現在出發，否則會錯過火車。
optionPinyin: nǐ zuìhǎo xiànzài chūfā, suǒyǐ huì cuòguò huǒchē
nǐ zuìhǎo xiànzài chūfā, suīrán huì cuòguò huǒchē
nǐ zuìhǎo xiànzài chūfā, fǒuzé huì cuòguò huǒchē
explanation: 否则 / 否則 (fǒuzé) means “otherwise” and introduces the bad result of not doing what was just suggested. 错过 / 錯過 (cuòguò) means “to miss.”

question: Only after I came here did I realize how big China is.
simplifiedOptions: 因为中国很大，所以我来了这里。
直到来了这里，我才发现中国有多大。
我早就知道中国有多大。
traditionalOptions: 因為中國很大，所以我來了這裡。
直到來了這裡，我才發現中國有多大。
我早就知道中國有多大。
optionPinyin: yīnwèi Zhōngguó hěn dà, suǒyǐ wǒ lái le zhèlǐ
zhídào lái le zhèlǐ, wǒ cái fāxiàn Zhōngguó yǒu duō dà
wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào Zhōngguó yǒu duō dà
explanation: 直到……才…… (zhídào…cái…) means “not until…did (I)…”. 发现 / 發現 (fāxiàn) means “to discover” or “to realize.”

question: White
explanation: 白色 (báisè) means “white.” 黑色 (hēisè) is “black,” and 黄色 / 黃色 (huángsè) is “yellow.”

question: I am American.
explanation: Country name + 人 (rén, “person”) gives nationality: 美国人 / 美國人 is “American,” 中国人 / 中國人 is “Chinese,” and 日本人 is “Japanese.”

question: Seven
explanation: 七 (qī) means “seven.” 六 (liù) is “six,” and 八 (bā) is “eight.” The characters are the same in both scripts.

question: You're welcome.
explanation: 不客气 / 不客氣 (bú kèqi) means “you're welcome” (literally “don't be polite”). 谢谢 / 謝謝 is “thank you,” and 对不起 / 對不起 is “sorry.”

question: Evening
explanation: 晚上 (wǎnshang) means “evening” or “night.” 早上 (zǎoshang) is “morning,” and 下午 (xiàwǔ) is “afternoon.”

question: I'd like a bowl of noodles.
explanation: 碗 (wǎn) is the measure word for bowls, and 面条 / 麵條 (miàntiáo) means “noodles.” 杯 (bēi) is for cups, and 个 / 個 (ge) is a general measure word.

question: I have a dog.
explanation: 有 (yǒu) means “to have,” and 只 / 隻 (zhī) is the measure word for most animals. 没有 / 沒有 means “don't have,” and 喜欢 / 喜歡 means “like.”

question: Can I pay by card?
explanation: 刷卡 (shuā kǎ) means “to pay by card” (literally “swipe a card”). 便宜一点儿 / 便宜一點兒 means “a bit cheaper,” and 袋子 (dàizi) means “bag.”

question: I'd like one ticket to Beijing.
optionPinyin: wǒ yào yì zhāng qù Shànghǎi de piào
wǒ yào yì zhāng qù Běijīng de piào
wǒ yào liǎng zhāng qù Běijīng de piào
explanation: 张 / 張 (zhāng) is the measure word for tickets, and 去北京的票 means “a ticket to Beijing.” 一 means “one,” while 两 / 兩 means “two.”

question: I go to bed at eleven o'clock.
explanation: 睡觉 / 睡覺 (shuìjiào) means “to sleep” or “to go to bed.” 起床 (qǐchuáng) means “to get up,” and 上班 (shàngbān) means “to go to work.”

question: I'm learning to play the guitar.
explanation: 在 + verb marks an ongoing action, 学 / 學 (xué) means “to learn,” and 弹吉他 / 彈吉他 (tán jítā) means “to play the guitar.”

question: It's a bit cold today, so wear more clothes.
simplifiedOptions: 今天很热，少穿点儿衣服。
今天有点儿冷，多穿点儿衣服。
traditionalOptions: 今天很熱，少穿點兒衣服。
今天有點兒冷，多穿點兒衣服。
optionPinyin: jīntiān hěn rè, shǎo chuān diǎnr yīfu
jīntiān yǒudiǎnr lěng, duō chuān diǎnr yīfu
explanation: 穿 (chuān) means “to wear” clothes. 多 (duō) means “more” and 少 (shǎo) means “less,” and 有点儿 / 有點兒 means “a bit.”

question: The library closes at six o'clock.
explanation: 关门 / 關門 (guānmén) means “to close” (a shop or building), and 开门 / 開門 (kāimén) means “to open.” 开会 / 開會 means “to have a meeting.”

question: My grandmother lives with us.
simplifiedOptions: 我奶奶跟我们住在一起。
我奶奶住在很远的地方。
traditionalOptions: 我奶奶跟我們住在一起。
我奶奶住在很遠的地方。
optionPinyin: wǒ nǎinai gēn wǒmen zhù zài yìqǐ
wǒ nǎinai zhù zài hěn yuǎn de dìfang
wǒ nǎinai bú zhù zài jiālǐ
explanation: 跟……住在一起 (gēn…zhù zài yìqǐ) means “to live together with…”. 很远 / 很遠 (hěn yuǎn) means “very far.”

question: I've had a cough for three days.
optionPinyin: wǒ sān tiān hòu huì késou
explanation: Verb + duration + 了 (le) means “has been … for …”. 三天 means “three days,” while 三次 means “three times.”

question: I'm preparing for the HSK exam.
optionPinyin: wǒ yǐjīng tōngguò le HSK kǎoshì
wǒ bù xiǎng cānjiā HSK kǎoshì
explanation: 正在 (zhèngzài) means “in the process of,” and 准备 / 準備 (zhǔnbèi) means “to prepare.” 参加 / 參加 (cānjiā) means “to take part in.”

question: Please be quiet; the baby is sleeping.
simplifiedOptions: 请安静一点，宝宝在睡觉。
traditionalOptions: 請安靜一點，寶寶在睡覺。
optionPinyin: qǐng dàshēng yìdiǎn, bǎobao zài wán
qǐng ānjìng yìdiǎn, bǎobao zài shuìjiào
explanation: 安静 / 安靜 (ānjìng) means “quiet,” and 宝宝 / 寶寶 (bǎobao) means “baby.” 大声 / 大聲 (dàshēng) means “loudly.”

question: After I finish work, I go to the gym.
simplifiedOptions: 我一边下班，一边去健身房。
traditionalOptions: 我一邊下班，一邊去健身房。
optionPinyin: wǒ yìbiān xiàbān, yìbiān qù jiànshēnfáng
explanation: 以后 / 以後 (yǐhòu) means “after,” and the earlier event comes first. 下班 (xiàbān) means “to finish work.”

question: He is the tallest in our class.
optionPinyin: tā bǐ wǒmen bān de rén ǎi
tā shì wǒmen bān zuì gāo de
explanation: 最 (zuì) means “most” and forms superlatives: 最高 is “tallest.” 班 (bān) means “class,” and 矮 (ǎi) means “short.”

question: It might rain tomorrow, so let's decide later.
simplifiedOptions: 明天一定会下雨，所以我们不去了。
明天不会下雨，我们去爬山吧。
明天可能会下雨，我们以后再决定吧。
traditionalOptions: 明天一定會下雨，所以我們不去了。
明天不會下雨，我們去爬山吧。
明天可能會下雨，我們以後再決定吧。
optionPinyin: míngtiān yídìng huì xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen bú qù le
míngtiān bú huì xiàyǔ, wǒmen qù páshān ba
míngtiān kěnéng huì xiàyǔ, wǒmen yǐhòu zài juédìng ba
explanation: 可能 (kěnéng) means “maybe” or “possibly,” while 一定 (yídìng) means “definitely.” 再 (zài) here means “then” or “later.”

question: Could you recommend a good restaurant?
simplifiedOptions: 你能推荐一家好餐厅吗？
你能帮我订一张机票吗？
你能告诉我现在几点吗？
traditionalOptions: 你能推薦一家好餐廳嗎？
你能幫我訂一張機票嗎？
你能告訴我現在幾點嗎？
optionPinyin: nǐ néng tuījiàn yì jiā hǎo cāntīng ma?
nǐ néng bāng wǒ dìng yì zhāng jīpiào ma?
nǐ néng gàosu wǒ xiànzài jǐ diǎn ma?
explanation: 推荐 / 推薦 (tuījiàn) means “to recommend,” and 家 (jiā) is the measure word for restaurants and businesses. 订机票 / 訂機票 means “to book a flight.”

question: Although he is over seventy, he still works every day.
simplifiedOptions: 尽管他已经七十多岁了，还是每天工作。
因为他已经七十多岁了，所以每天工作。
如果他七十多岁了，就不工作。
traditionalOptions: 儘管他已經七十多歲了，還是每天工作。
因為他已經七十多歲了，所以每天工作。
如果他七十多歲了，就不工作。
optionPinyin: jǐnguǎn tā yǐjīng qīshí duō suì le, háishi měitiān gōngzuò
yīnwèi tā yǐjīng qīshí duō suì le, suǒyǐ měitiān gōngzuò
rúguǒ tā qīshí duō suì le, jiù bù gōngzuò
explanation: 尽管……还是…… / 儘管……還是…… (jǐnguǎn…háishi…) means “even though…, still…”. It is a somewhat formal way to express concession, similar to 虽然……但是……

question: Take a coat so you don't catch a cold.
optionPinyin: dài shàng wàitào, suǒyǐ gǎnmào le
gǎnmào le, yǐmiǎn dài shàng wàitào
explanation: 以免 (yǐmiǎn) means “so as not to” or “lest.” It introduces the bad outcome that the first action is meant to prevent.

question: I was moved by his story.
optionPinyin: wǒ bǎ tā de gùshi gǎndòng le
tā bèi wǒ de gùshi gǎndòng le
wǒ bèi tā de gùshi gǎndòng le
explanation: 被……感动 / 被……感動 (bèi…gǎndòng) means “to be moved by…”. 被 marks the person affected (“I”) and introduces the cause (“his story”).

question: Making mistakes is unavoidable when you first start learning.
simplifiedOptions: 刚开始学习时，犯错是难免的。
刚开始学习时，犯错是不可能的。
刚开始学习时，犯错是不必要的。
traditionalOptions: 剛開始學習時，犯錯是難免的。
剛開始學習時，犯錯是不可能的。
剛開始學習時，犯錯是不必要的。
optionPinyin: gāng kāishǐ xuéxí shí, fàncuò shì nánmiǎn de
gāng kāishǐ xuéxí shí, fàncuò shì bù kěnéng de
gāng kāishǐ xuéxí shí, fàncuò shì bú bìyào de
explanation: 难免 / 難免 (nánmiǎn) means “unavoidable” or “bound to happen.” 犯错 / 犯錯 (fàncuò) means “to make a mistake.”

question: Let's take advantage of the good weather and go for a walk.
simplifiedOptions: 因为天气好，所以我们没出去。
趁着天气好，我们出去走走吧。
天气好的时候，我们已经回家了。
traditionalOptions: 因為天氣好，所以我們沒出去。
趁著天氣好，我們出去走走吧。
天氣好的時候，我們已經回家了。
optionPinyin: yīnwèi tiānqì hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi chūqù
chènzhe tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen chūqù zǒuzou ba
tiānqì hǎo de shíhou, wǒmen yǐjīng huí jiā le
explanation: 趁着 / 趁著 (chènzhe) means “taking advantage of” a good opportunity. 走走 (zǒuzou) is a reduplicated verb meaning “to stroll.”

question: He failed; however, he didn't lose heart.
simplifiedOptions: 他失败了，因此他很灰心。
他成功了，然而他很灰心。
他失败了，然而他没有灰心。
traditionalOptions: 他失敗了，因此他很灰心。
他成功了，然而他很灰心。
他失敗了，然而他沒有灰心。
optionPinyin: tā shībài le, yīncǐ tā hěn huīxīn
tā chénggōng le, rán'ér tā hěn huīxīn
tā shībài le, rán'ér tā méiyǒu huīxīn
explanation: 然而 (rán'ér) means “however” and is a formal word signalling contrast. 因此 (yīncǐ) means “therefore,” and 灰心 (huīxīn) means “to lose heart.”

question: Whether or not he comes, we will start on time.
simplifiedOptions: 不管他来不来，我们都会准时开始。
如果他来，我们就会准时开始。
因为他来了，所以我们准时开始。
traditionalOptions: 不管他來不來，我們都會準時開始。
如果他來，我們就會準時開始。
因為他來了，所以我們準時開始。
optionPinyin: bùguǎn tā lái bu lái, wǒmen dōu huì zhǔnshí kāishǐ
rúguǒ tā lái, wǒmen jiù huì zhǔnshí kāishǐ
yīnwèi tā lái le, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhǔnshí kāishǐ
explanation: 不管……都…… (bùguǎn…dōu…) means “regardless of whether…”. The verb-not-verb form 来不来 / 來不來 gives the two alternatives.

question: He could hardly believe his eyes.
simplifiedOptions: 他完全相信自己的眼睛。
他简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
traditionalOptions: 他完全相信自己的眼睛。
他簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
optionPinyin: tā wánquán xiāngxìn zìjǐ de yǎnjing
tā jiǎnzhí bù gǎn xiāngxìn zìjǐ de yǎnjing
explanation: 简直 / 簡直 (jiǎnzhí) means “simply” or “virtually” and adds emphasis. 不敢相信 (bù gǎn xiāngxìn) means “can't believe.”

question: She is very good at expressing her ideas.
simplifiedOptions: 她很不愿意表达自己的想法。
她很善于表达自己的想法。
她刚学会表达自己的想法。
traditionalOptions: 她很不願意表達自己的想法。
她很善於表達自己的想法。
她剛學會表達自己的想法。
optionPinyin: tā hěn bú yuànyì biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ
tā hěn shànyú biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ
tā gāng xuéhuì biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ
explanation: 善于 / 善於 (shànyú) means “to be good at,” and 表达 / 表達 (biǎodá) means “to express.” 愿意 / 願意 means “willing,” and 刚学会 / 剛學會 means “just learned how to.”

question: Hand
explanation: 手 (shǒu) means “hand.” 脚 / 腳 (jiǎo) is “foot,” and 头 / 頭 (tóu) is “head.”

question: Egg
explanation: 鸡蛋 / 雞蛋 (jīdàn) means “egg” (literally “chicken egg”). 牛肉 (niúròu) is “beef,” and 鱼 / 魚 (yú) is “fish.”

question: Happy birthday!
explanation: 生日快乐 / 生日快樂 (shēngrì kuàilè) means “happy birthday.” 快乐 / 快樂 means “happy,” and 新年 (xīnnián) means “New Year.”

question: Nine
explanation: 九 (jiǔ) means “nine.” 六 (liù) is “six,” and 八 (bā) is “eight.” The characters are the same in both scripts.

question: My grandfather (father's side)
explanation: 爷爷 / 爺爺 (yéye) means “grandfather” on the father's side. 奶奶 (nǎinai) is the matching “grandmother,” and 爸爸 (bàba) is “dad.”

question: I'm thirsty.
explanation: 渴 (kě) means “thirsty.” 热 / 熱 (rè) means “hot,” and 累 (lèi) means “tired.”

question: He is at home.
explanation: 在 (zài) means “to be at,” and 家 (jiā) means “home.” 学校 / 學校 (xuéxiào) is “school,” and 商店 (shāngdiàn) is “shop.”

question: It's windy today.
explanation: 刮风 / 刮風 (guāfēng) means “windy” (literally “the wind blows”). 下雪 (xiàxuě) means “to snow,” and 热 / 熱 (rè) means “hot.”

question: How do I get to the museum?
explanation: 怎么走 / 怎麼走 (zěnme zǒu) means “how do I get there?” (literally “how to walk”). 几点开门 / 幾點開門 asks “what time does it open,” and 多少钱 / 多少錢 asks “how much.”

question: Is this spicy?
explanation: 辣 (là) means “spicy.” 贵 / 貴 (guì) means “expensive,” and 甜 (tián) means “sweet.” 吗 / 嗎 (ma) turns a statement into a yes-or-no question.

question: I take a shower every evening.
explanation: 洗澡 (xǐzǎo) means “to take a bath or shower,” and 晚上 (wǎnshang) means “evening.” 跑步 (pǎobù) means “to run,” and 中午 (zhōngwǔ) means “noon.”

question: I have an English class tomorrow.
explanation: 英语 / 英語 (Yīngyǔ) means “English,” and 课 / 課 (kè) means “class” or “lesson.” 数学 / 數學 is “math,” and 音乐 / 音樂 is “music.”

question: I have a fever.
explanation: 发烧 / 發燒 (fāshāo) means “to have a fever.” 咳嗽 (késou) means “to cough,” and 受伤 / 受傷 (shòushāng) means “to get injured.”

question: I like taking photos.
explanation: 拍照 (pāizhào) means “to take photos.” 画画 / 畫畫 (huà huà) means “to draw,” and 跳舞 (tiàowǔ) means “to dance.”

question: I haven't decided where to go yet.
optionPinyin: wǒ hái méi juédìng qù nǎlǐ
wǒ yǐjīng juédìng qù Běijīng le
explanation: 还没 / 還沒 (hái méi) means “not yet,” and 决定 / 決定 (juédìng) means “to decide.” 已经 / 已經 means “already,” and 谁 / 誰 means “who.”

question: I think learning Chinese is not easy.
optionPinyin: wǒ juéde xué Zhōngwén bù róngyì
wǒ juéde xué Zhōngwén hěn róngyì
explanation: 容易 (róngyì) means “easy,” so 不容易 means “not easy.” 有名 (yǒumíng) means “famous.”

question: I have to finish this report before Friday.
simplifiedOptions: 我这个星期五不用交报告。
我得在星期五以前写完这份报告。
traditionalOptions: 我這個星期五不用交報告。
我得在星期五以前寫完這份報告。
optionPinyin: wǒ zhège xīngqīwǔ búyòng jiāo bàogào
wǒ yǐjīng xiě wán bàogào le
wǒ děi zài xīngqīwǔ yǐqián xiě wán zhè fèn bàogào
explanation: 得 (děi) means “must,” and 以前 (yǐqián) means “before.” 写完 / 寫完 (xiě wán) means “finish writing,” and 份 (fèn) is the measure word for reports and documents.

question: I've never been abroad.
optionPinyin: wǒ cónglái méi chū guo guó
wǒ qùnián chū guo liǎng cì guó
explanation: 出国 / 出國 (chūguó) means “to go abroad,” and 从来没……过 / 從來沒……過 (cónglái méi…guo) means “have never…”. 打算 means “plan to.”

question: Don't worry; everything will be fine.
optionPinyin: bié shēngqì, xià cì zài nǔlì
bié jǐnzhāng, wǒmen míngtiān zài lái
bié dānxīn, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo de
explanation: 别 / 別 (bié) means “don't,” 担心 / 擔心 (dānxīn) means “to worry,” and 一切 (yíqiè) means “everything.” 生气 / 生氣 means “angry,” and 紧张 / 緊張 means “nervous.”

question: I used to be afraid of dogs, but now I'm not.
simplifiedOptions: 我以前怕狗，现在不怕了。
我以前不怕狗，现在怕了。
traditionalOptions: 我以前怕狗，現在不怕了。
我以前不怕狗，現在怕了。
optionPinyin: wǒ yǐqián pà gǒu, xiànzài bú pà le
wǒ yǐqián bú pà gǒu, xiànzài pà le
wǒ yǐqián hé xiànzài dōu pà gǒu
explanation: 怕 (pà) means “to be afraid of,” and 不……了 (bù…le) means “no longer…”. 以前 means “before,” and 现在 / 現在 means “now.”

question: Could you turn the volume down a bit?
simplifiedOptions: 你能把声音调大一点儿吗？
你能把声音调小一点儿吗？
traditionalOptions: 你能把聲音調大一點兒嗎？
你能把聲音調小一點兒嗎？
optionPinyin: nǐ néng bǎ shēngyīn tiáo dà yìdiǎnr ma?
nǐ néng bǎ yīnyuè guāndiào ma?
nǐ néng bǎ shēngyīn tiáo xiǎo yìdiǎnr ma?
explanation: 调小 / 調小 (tiáo xiǎo) means “to turn down,” and 调大 / 調大 means “to turn up.” 声音 / 聲音 (shēngyīn) means “sound” or “volume,” and 关掉 / 關掉 means “to turn off.”

question: It's not so much that he's lazy as that he lacks confidence.
simplifiedOptions: 与其说他懒，不如说他缺乏自信。
他不但懒，而且缺乏自信。
他虽然懒，但是很有自信。
traditionalOptions: 與其說他懶，不如說他缺乏自信。
他不但懶，而且缺乏自信。
他雖然懶，但是很有自信。
optionPinyin: yǔqí shuō tā lǎn, bùrú shuō tā quēfá zìxìn
tā búdàn lǎn, érqiě quēfá zìxìn
tā suīrán lǎn, dànshì hěn yǒu zìxìn
explanation: 与其说……不如说…… / 與其說……不如說…… (yǔqí shuō…bùrú shuō…) means “it's not so much … as …”. It offers a more accurate description in place of the first one.

question: I wanted to go out, but it just had to start raining.
simplifiedOptions: 我想出去玩，所以下起雨来了。
我想出去玩，不过没有下雨。
我想出去玩，偏偏下起雨来了。
traditionalOptions: 我想出去玩，所以下起雨來了。
我想出去玩，不過沒有下雨。
我想出去玩，偏偏下起雨來了。
optionPinyin: wǒ xiǎng chūqù wán, suǒyǐ xià qǐ yǔ lái le
wǒ xiǎng chūqù wán, búguò méiyǒu xiàyǔ
wǒ xiǎng chūqù wán, piānpiān xià qǐ yǔ lái le
explanation: 偏偏 (piānpiān) means “just (unluckily)” and shows events going against one's wishes. 下起雨来 / 下起雨來 (xià qǐ yǔ lái) means “to start raining.”

question: As time goes by, his Chinese is getting better and better.
simplifiedOptions: 随着时间的推移，他的中文越来越好。
随着时间的推移，他的中文越来越差。
虽然时间推移了，他的中文还是没变化。
traditionalOptions: 隨著時間的推移，他的中文越來越好。
隨著時間的推移，他的中文越來越差。
雖然時間推移了，他的中文還是沒變化。
optionPinyin: suízhe shíjiān de tuīyí, tā de Zhōngwén yuèláiyuè hǎo
suízhe shíjiān de tuīyí, tā de Zhōngwén yuèláiyuè chà
suīrán shíjiān tuīyí le, tā de Zhōngwén háishi méi biànhuà
explanation: 随着 / 隨著 (suízhe) means “along with” or “as,” and 越来越 / 越來越 (yuèláiyuè) means “more and more.” 差 (chà) means “poor,” so the second option says the opposite.

question: The boss made him work overtime.
explanation: A 让 / 讓 (ràng) B + verb means “A makes (or lets) B do…”. The person right after 让 is the one who does the action, so here 他 (he) works overtime. 陪 (péi) means “to accompany.”

question: In fact, he knew all along; he just didn't say anything.
simplifiedOptions: 其实他早就知道了，只是没说。
其实他刚知道，所以没说。
其实他不知道，所以说了。
traditionalOptions: 其實他早就知道了，只是沒說。
其實他剛知道，所以沒說。
其實他不知道，所以說了。
optionPinyin: qíshí tā zǎo jiù zhīdào le, zhǐshì méi shuō
qíshí tā gāng zhīdào, suǒyǐ méi shuō
qíshí tā bù zhīdào, suǒyǐ shuō le
explanation: 其实 / 其實 (qíshí) means “in fact,” 早就……了 (zǎo jiù…le) means “already long ago,” and 只是 (zhǐshì) means “it's just that…”.

question: If it hadn't been for your help, I couldn't have finished.
simplifiedOptions: 因为你帮忙，我才没完成。
虽然你帮忙，我还是完成了。
要不是你帮忙，我就完不成了。
traditionalOptions: 因為你幫忙，我才沒完成。
雖然你幫忙，我還是完成了。
要不是你幫忙，我就完不成了。
optionPinyin: yīnwèi nǐ bāngmáng, wǒ cái méi wánchéng
suīrán nǐ bāngmáng, wǒ háishi wánchéng le
yàobushi nǐ bāngmáng, wǒ jiù wán bù chéng le
explanation: 要不是……就…… (yàobushi…jiù…) means “if it weren't for…, then…”. 完不成 (wán bù chéng) is a potential complement meaning “unable to complete.”

question: Needless to say, health is more important than money.
simplifiedOptions: 不用说，健康比金钱更重要。
不用说，金钱比健康更重要。
不用说，健康和金钱一样重要。
traditionalOptions: 不用說，健康比金錢更重要。
不用說，金錢比健康更重要。
不用說，健康和金錢一樣重要。
optionPinyin: búyòng shuō, jiànkāng bǐ jīnqián gèng zhòngyào
búyòng shuō, jīnqián bǐ jiànkāng gèng zhòngyào
búyòng shuō, jiànkāng hé jīnqián yíyàng zhòngyào
explanation: 不用说 / 不用說 (búyòng shuō) means “needless to say.” A 比 B 更 + adjective means “A is even more … than B,” so the word order decides which one matters more.
